title: $35 to watch hugh jackman and ella beatty emotionally wreck each othe...
transcript: Hugh Jackman is currently in a play in a 400-seat house in the West Village where you can get tickets for $35 it's called Sexual Misconducts of the Middle Classes and it's just him and Ella Beatty going head to head on stage for 90 minutes he plays John a famous novelist and professor she's Annie his 19 year old student and a huge fan the play written by Hannah Moscovitch is it actually told from john’s perspective as you see through his eyes a teenager with a crush which quickly blurs into something much more complicated it's intimate and intense and makes you question who holds the power and how narratives are shaped the show is unsettling and it really makes you think getting to watch these two actors do this show in such an intimate space is unreal it almost feels like you're eavesdropping on something you shouldn't be hearing but you can't look away and I love that they are making tickets so accessible 25% of the seats in the theater are being reserved for day of ticketing which you can get through a todaytix lottery or at the box office for $35 and it's being recorded and will be released on audible so if you miss it in person you can still hear it later but if you want to see it in person it's running until June 18th at Minetta Lane
